title: Front Cover Art
prompt:
Full-color premium children's fantasy book cover illustration in a modern animated-feature film style with painterly, polished rendering and cinematic global illumination. Scene features Elliott (age 4-5) with short straight light-brown hair, big gray-blue eyes, round cheeks, friendly adventurous expression, wearing a medieval tunic with belt and boots or casual explorer outfit; Colette (age 2-3) with wavy brown hair in a top knot, large gray-blue eyes, soft cheeks, wearing a whimsical princess-meets-adventurer dress with floral or heart motifs; and Winnie, a small tan Chihuahua–Pug mix with upright ears and curled tail, all in the foreground discovering a swirling magical portal in a forest clearing. Behind them rises a large friendly dragon with wings subtly framing the composition. A distant castle silhouette is visible beyond the trees. The forest environment is rendered in cool twilight blues, indigo, and soft violet with shadows leaning blue-violet or teal. The portal emits a warm golden key light with soft falloff illuminating faces and nearby ground, creating strong warm–cool color separation. Soft rim lighting separates characters from the background, with subtle cool moonlight or sky fill balancing the warm portal light. Warm light is localized and does not flood the entire scene. The background is cool and magical with soft volumetric glow around the portal and light mist or particles catching cool blue light in the distance. Composition fills the lower 65–75% of the cover with the top 25% reserved as open cool-toned sky for the title. The title text "The Dragon Realm Adventure" is centered in the top sky area with generous top margin, in elegant fantasy serif typography with gold-ivory lettering, subtle bevel, and soft warm glow, professionally rendered with clean, readable letterforms and correct spelling. No outlines or heavy black contours; edges defined by light and color transitions. No chibi style; natural child proportions and expressive faces. No watermark, no extra text, no placeholder boxes or fake lettering. The illustration uses strong warm–cool color contrast, smooth gradients, volumetric glow, and painterly lighting, resembling a frame from a high-end animated fantasy film.

Use the attached character sheet reference images as the canonical identity and style.
